The provided text aligns closely with the standard themes of the cyberpunk genre. It features a dystopian urban setting (Neo-Tokyo), a stark contrast between high technology and low life, the dominance of powerful megacorporations, and the central role of hackers and digital consciousness. The motif of information as currency and the blurring line between reality and the virtual world are classic tropes that define this literary style.

Regarding your question about dental hygiene, I use a toothbrush to clean my teeth.
